title: leucanthemella serotina
intro: Leucanthemella serotina, commonly known as late-flowering daisy or autumn daisy, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to Europe and Asia. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that aid in relieving digestive issues and reducing the risk of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemella serotina include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it effective in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
